notes.notes:
Ver. 1.01 update was released on July 25, 2024.

■Update Details
・Adjustment of some English translations
・Implementation of the function to stop or turn off the sound when sending a message.
・Correction of minor bugs

The save data of the previous version can be transferred.

notes.title: Demo version has been released!
notes.notes:
■Demo version details
Including the main character duo "Hiira Trao" and "Rikudo Rinne", "Ichigase Ten" and "Hu Yuen" who are active in "Shinjuku Kowloon" , you can experience the early part of the game (approximately 1 hour) where the main characters appear in "SHINJUKU SOUMEI Demo".

■About the play commentary and live stream rules for the demo version
"SHINJUKU SOUMEI Demo" can be distributed from the opening to the end of the demo version.
*No delivery restrictions
Please feel free to share the story of "SHINJUKU SOUMEI" on YouTube.
